div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Memory updates are
conditional on feature/cadence gates and run after response persistence. Failed updates preserve/skip memory appropriately. These controls remain in sequence 40 and the source dictionary.
